sources.title: oaklight/krino-qwen3.5-4b-heads · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Lightweight decision heads trained on a frozen Qwen3.5-4B-Base backbone. Outputs typed, calibrated decisions (noul / choice / score) instead of text. 1M trainable params on a 4.2B frozen backbone. 65.4% aggregate accuracy across 19 benchmarks.

sources.title: Qwen3-Reranker-4B · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Qwen3 Reranker 4B Highlights The Qwen3 Embedding model series is the latest proprietary model of the Qwen family, specifically designed for text embedding and ranking tasks. Building upon the dense foundational models of the Qwen3 series, it provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings and reranking models in various sizes (0.6B, 4B, and 8B).

sources.title: Qwen3-Reranker-4B - regolo.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3-Reranker-4B is a text reranking model in the Qwen3 Embedding and Reranker series, built specifically for ranking tasks on top of the dense Qwen3 foundation models. It is designed for multilingual retrieval, long-text understanding, and reasoning-heavy ranking workflows, with support for 100+ languages and a 32K context window.
